Breakfast and transfer to Punta Arenas Airport (about 3 hours) for the regional DAP Airlines flight to Balmaceda (about 2 hours). On arrival, meet your local driver-guide and set off along the legendary Carretera Austral, through the endless Patagonian steppe and the wide valleys of the Aysén region, as arid plains give way to forested slopes and the bright turquoise waters of Lake General Carrera. Arrival in Puerto Río Tranquilo after about 5 hours.

Accommodation: Mallín Colorado Ecolodge or similar, Cabaña Coigüe, breakfast

Day 8 · Breakfast and transfer to Santiago Airport for the flight to Puerto Natales, gateway to Torres del Paine (about 3 hours 20 minutes). On arrival, transfer to the hotel by SUV (Subaru Outback or similar, about 20 minutes). Free evening.
